name: Creative quality
evidence: QC/critique events per ad; src/lib/product-intel/creative.ts, critique.ts tests. Measurable: Share of generated ads passing QC and the critique rubric on first render; no unsupported claims.
owner_action: Needs real packs and customer ratings to calibrate the rubric.

name: Advertising effectiveness
evidence: src/lib/product-intel/effectiveness.ts tests; Meta insights. Measurable: Cost per lead / CTR of published ads vs the customer's own baseline.
owner_action: Needs real Meta spend from paying customers (currently ~1 buyer).

name: Self-learning campaigns
evidence: Optimizer/outcome events; src/lib/optimizer tests. Measurable: Next week's ads change because of last week's results.
owner_action: Needs live spend and results to learn from.

name: Complete customer problem solving
evidence: engine/src/customersuccess; product_loop ingests customer_success_finding. Measurable: Share of customer problems (support replies, stuck states) resolved without the founder.
owner_action: Needs real replies and failures to cluster.

name: Radical simplicity
evidence: docs/product/friction-map.md; reliability snapshot time_to_first_ad. Measurable: Steps and minutes from link to first ad; fewer decisions asked of the owner.
owner_action: Needs funnel volume for drop-off rates.

name: Customer-specific intelligence
evidence: docs/product/customer-intel.md; tests in src/lib/customer-intel. Measurable: Ads and advice reflect the customer's trade, area and history.
owner_action: Needs real customers to validate relevance.

name: Agency product excellence
evidence: docs/product/agency-gaps.md. Measurable: Agency-grade deliverables (reporting, multi-brand, white-label gaps) identified and closed.
owner_action: Needs agency users to confirm priorities.

name: Competitive superiority
evidence: src/lib/product-intel/__tests__/reliability-econ-loop.test.ts (competitive block); npx tsx scripts/competitive-scan.ts. Measurable: Transparent scorecard vs alternatives from public facts; differentiators proposed, not claimed.
owner_action: Canva, Pencil, Smartly, Meta Advantage+ not yet verified (run scan with --fetch and review); customer-win evidence needs real results.

name: Outcome verification
evidence: docs/product/outcomes.md; outcome tests. Measurable: Claims about results are verified against measured data before they are shown.

name: Autonomous product improvement
evidence: vitest: product loop block; AdsEvent product_backlog / product_digest / product_auto_applied. Measurable: Weekly ranked backlog and plain-English what-to-build-next; config-only auto-apply within an allow-list.
owner_action: Ranking quality needs real signals; turn on sys_product_loop after deploy. Owner approves backlog status changes.

name: Reliability
evidence: vitest: reliability block; admin card /admin/ads/product. Measurable: SLO: >= 97% of standard packs finish with >= 8 ads within 10 minutes; outages and stuck jobs detected same day.
owner_action: SLO needs >= 10 finished packs per window; provider/model split needs the engine to record provider in AdJob result (today often 'unknown').

name: Delivery economics
evidence: vitest: delivery economics block; admin card. Measurable: Known cost to deliver per pack/ad/video/Studio turn and gross margin per plan and offer ($9 unlock, $97 first month, $297 plan, free pack as acquisition cost).
owner_action: Costs are API-list equivalents (Codex is flat-rate): margins conservative. Utilisation (share of credits used) needs real subscriber data.

name: Collective intelligence
evidence: Not yet built here. Measurable: Patterns learned across customers (trade, template, hook) improve everyone's output without leaking one customer's data.
owner_action: Needs many customers; privacy review before any cross-customer use.

name: Autonomous operation
evidence: src/lib/growth/systems.ts health; flags page. Measurable: Systems run, heartbeat, alert on failure and stop safely without the founder.
owner_action: Needs a deployed engine and flags turned on by the owner.
